title: Chapter 708
text:
The scale of the Black Star Corps shocked the players. The video continued to play, and the scene changed. Finally, it began to talk about what the players were most curious about — the specific deeds of the Black Star Corps in the past ten years.

"In Galaxy Year 695, the Red Empire expanded, codenamed Crimson Tide. Due to its influence, the Shattered Star Ring was in turmoil. The Klent Kingdom ordered the Bloodshed Land to invade the Amethyst Civilization. The secret war broke out, and the Black Star Corps joined Purple Crystal to fight for them. The war lasted for ten years and has yet to end. During this period, the Black Star Corps fought hundreds of battles, clashing with the Bloodshed Land time and time again, making a name for itself … "

Rossellin introduced the background of the secret war, and everyone was shocked.

Crimson Tide? Isn't that the name of the version? So, it really refers to the expansion of the Red Empire. At the end of Version 2.0, Black Star had vaguely revealed some information. It turned out that it was really the hidden information of the next version.

The Black Star Corps actually got involved in the war of a Star Cluster Civilization. This meant that the Main Storyline of Version 3.0 should be related to the secret war … many people guessed.

Following this train of thought, the expansion of the Black Star Corps definitely had something to do with participating in the war. They should have made a fortune from the war.

However, they only guessed half of it right. The following content instantly ignited everyone's passion.

"… In this war, Leader Black Star revealed his potential as a Beyond Grade A and crushed all the high-level combatants of the enemy. He is the one with the greatest hope of becoming the next Beyond Grade A of the Shattered Star Ring in the past few decades. At the same time, the Black Star Army expanded greatly under his leadership and was roped in by Purple Crystal and dozens of Star System civilizations. Finally, it reached its current scale."

As the leader of the faction, Rossellin introduced Han Xiao in detail. She explained his terrifying battle record and the important influence he had on the development of the Black Star Corps.

The players understood what the video meant. The reason the Black Star Corps could develop to its current level was ninety percent because of Black Star. If not for Han Xiao's Beyond Grade A potential, the Black Star Corps would not have been able to stand out even if they participated in the war.

It was Black Star who had expanded the army to this extent in just ten years!

The players came to a sudden realization and instantly understood the crux of the matter.

Beyond Grade A!

After two versions, they already knew that Black Star was very strong, but they did not expect that Black Star could still break their old impression and give them a new surprise!

Beyond Grade As were the supreme beings standing at the peak of the galaxy. Black Star was a character that appeared in Version 1.0, and the storyline ran through three versions. Now, he actually had the qualifications to become a supreme being, so he would probably be a main character in Version 3.0 as well.

Han Xiao had long since become the Chinese players' 'own NPC'. Their sense of identity was off the charts. Seeing that their own faction's leader was even more ferocious than eating Viagra, the players were so excited that they couldn't close their mouths.

Before the version update, countless players had been looking forward to what the Black Star Corps would become in Version 3.0. They were very satisfied with the results and even felt surprised. When we weren't around, Black Star was as reliable as ever. He managed the Black Star Corps so well. It was awesome.

Our captain is still the best!

With such a strong leader, the faction would have an even higher development ceiling. The players' enthusiasm for the Black Star Corps greatly increased.

The video continued, and Rossellin went on to talk about what the Black Star Corps had experienced in the past ten years and what achievements they had made. Han Xiao's personal achievements were interspersed with the video. Countless times, he fought one against many, killed countless enemies, resolved assassination attempts, fought with EsGod, destroyed Dark-star, and so on.

The course introduced the history of the Black Star Army in a comprehensive manner. After the video ended, many of the players looked as though they had not had enough of it. Because they had already seen Bun-Hit-Dog's Black Star series, this video gave them the feeling that they were binge-watching a drama series. They had caught up to ten years of the Black Star Army's history in an instant, and there was a sense of epic change.

"This can be considered the background introduction of the new version."

"Why do I feel like it's more like a cutscene animation …"

"Black Star is awesome!"

"As expected of a growth-type faction. The future is bright, hahaha!"

The players present were still in high spirits, and they discussed fervently.

The changes in the Black Star Corps shocked them greatly. After the initial shock, they were overjoyed.

Since it was a good change, the players were relieved. The more impressive the Black Star Corps was, the happier they were. This was the faction that they had witnessed for three whole versions.

"I didn't expect so many things to happen while we were not around." Mad Blade could not help but sigh.

Pork Bun's heart ached. "So much news material. What a pity. How many videos could we make with that?"

The video went through the history of the Black Star Corps, and the players had a clearer understanding of the faction they were in. Han Xiao had been working hard to increase the sense of belonging of the players through the deeds of the faction, and the results were remarkable. A faction with a history had a unique culture, and the sense of belonging had always been one of the important factors that influenced the players apart from benefits.

Through the deeds of the past ten years, all the players had a basic understanding of the situation in Version 3.0. It could be said that under the guidance of Han Xiao, the players were adapting to Version 3.0 at the fastest speed possible. This was also what Han Xiao wanted to see.

The second round of the [Ten Years] mission had been completed, and Han Xiao immediately released the third round of the mission, continuing to guide the players remotely.

All the army players received a new guidance mission.

[Third Round]

Mission Introduction: You have understood the situation in the Shattered Star Ring. The Black Star Corps is participating in the secret war. As a member of the army, you have to make a choice.

Mission Requirements: Go through the internal program and accept the secret war mission.

"The main storyline can be triggered right from the start? Seems like it's the same as Version 2.0."

The version of the Mutation Disaster also triggered the main storyline right from the start, and the players did not have any doubts. Through Philip's sub-program, they clicked on the option to participate in the secret war.

In his previous life, after the players entered Version 3.0, they had to go through a period of exploration before participating in the main storyline of the secret war under the guidance of their respective factions. Now, Han Xiao had directly thrown the main storyline in front of the players, saving a lot of time. Letting the players participate in the war in advance was more beneficial to him.

Originally, the way to trigger the secret war main storyline was to join Bloodshed Land or Section Zero. However, Han Xiao had known about this long ago. Thus, he had used ten years to make the Black Star Corps an important member of Section Zero, connecting it to the main storyline and binding it to the faction. This way, the players did not need to join any other faction. As long as they stayed in the Black Star Corps, they would be able to participate in the secret war main storyline!

The results of Han Xiao's efforts during the version update were gradually showing.

Grade S Faction War Mission [Secret War Section Zero]!

Mission Introduction: The Klent Kingdom has invaded the territory of the Amethyst Civilization. You have chosen to stand on the side of the Amethyst Civilization.

Mission Requirements: Listen to orders and repel all enemies that have invaded the territory of the Colton Star Cluster.

After the mission is completed, different rewards will be given according to the mission rating.

Grade S Main Storyline Mission!

The eyes of the players sparkled. The Main Storyline Missions of the previous two versions were Grade A missions. This was the first time they had accepted a Grade S mission.

Han Xiao had received this Main Storyline Mission ten years earlier than the players. Although the Grade S mission rating would only be displayed after the mission was completed, he did not need to look to know that he had already reached the highest rating.

"This Main Storyline Mission has a suffix. Hmm, does this mean that we can also do this mission in the Klent faction?"

Bun-Hit-Dog was quick-witted. He deduced many things from one case and guessed the truth.

In the original storyline of his previous life, the players could choose to join either Klent or Purple Crystal. Both factions had their own attractions. The Colton Star Cluster, where Purple Crystal was located, was considered the birthplace of the players. As the defending side, they had a geographical advantage. The Tyrant of Bloodshed Land was a Beyond Grade A Super and had the initiative.

In Version 2.0 of the original storyline, the Black Star Corps did not exist. Godora and Dark-star were the organizations that led the players into the universe. They each recruited a portion of the players and walked on different paths.

Due to the relationship between Klent and DarkStar, a portion of the players recruited by DarkStar had joined the Klent faction in Version 3.0. Furthermore, due to the influence of the Tyrant, many players chose to join Bloodshed Land. Due to the fact that Section Zero was in a passive position, there were relatively few players who joined.

However, Han Xiao had already changed the direction of the storyline. He had laid a good foundation in Version 2.0, squeezing away Godora and Dark-star and almost all the Blue Star players.

Now, the Black Star Corps was the most important member of Section Zero. This meant that the players were innately standing in Purple Crystal's faction!

Only a child would choose. I want all of them!

If they wanted to join Klent, it would be equivalent to wasting all their investment in the Black Star Corps in the previous two versions. The cost of the players changing factions was extremely high. Although the players did not like being forced, with the sense of belonging in the previous two versions as a foundation, Han Xiao's act of acting first and reporting later would not cause the rebellious mentality of most of the players.

The Beyond Grade A Tyrant was indeed attractive. However, just now, the players had learned that Black Star also had the potential to become a Beyond Grade A Super. This caused the Bloodshed Land to lose its core competitiveness, and the attraction of the faction decreased drastically. At least, even if the majority of the players realized that they could change factions, they would not do so because it was not worth it.

Thus, it was impossible for Klent and Bloodshed Land to obtain a large number of players like in his previous life!

The butterfly effect caused by Han Xiao in Version 2.0 had continued to this day.

However, there were all kinds of strange players, and there might be some who wanted to join the Traitor's Association. Han Xiao had long prepared countermeasures.

In the past ten years, he had considered all kinds of possible accidents.

While the players were excitedly discussing the Main Storyline Mission, Han Xiao no longer pretended to look at the scenery and returned to the satellite fortress.

"The first step is complete. Next, it's time to fertilize …"

…
